# Optional photo-stack Rust dependencies

This source change vendors no provider, weights or Rust dependency source. Cargo
lockfiles pin the optional native build. No compiled binary or wheel is published.
Binary distributors must retain the applicable dependency notices with their
artifact; the platform build/packaging qualification remains separate.

The bindings and shadow scaffolding were generated by rust-anything 2.0.2 (MIT).
Its notice is retained in [licenses/rust-anything-MIT.txt](licenses/rust-anything-MIT.txt).

The local macOS build's resolved dependency licenses, read from Cargo metadata:

| Crate | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| pyo3, pyo3-build-config, pyo3-ffi, pyo3-macros, pyo3-macros-backend | 0.30.1 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| serde, serde_core, serde_derive | 1.0.229 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| serde_json | 1.0.154 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| heck | 0.5.0 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| itoa | 1.0.19 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| libc | 0.2.191 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| memchr | 2.8.3 | Unlicense OR MIT |
| once_cell | 1.21.4 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| proc-macro2 | 1.0.107 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| quote | 1.0.47 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| syn | 3.0.10 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| target-lexicon | 0.13.6 | Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception |
| unicode-ident | 1.0.27 | (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0 |
| zmij | 1.0.23 | MIT |

Use `cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --manifest-path
rust/photo-stack-python/Cargo.toml` for the target platform's complete resolved
dependency set, including target-specific crates. [PyO3](https://pyo3.rs/) supplies
the CPython bridge; [Serde](https://serde.rs/) supplies the bounded internal wire
conversion. Neither loads PhotoHouse models or changes provider licensing.
